name: Captopril
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Blocks conversion of angiotensin I to II

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

dosing.h: Congenital Heart Disease with Left to Right Shunt

items.t: Captopril, oral: · Infants: 0.15–0.3 mg/kg/dose, 8–12 hourly (maximum 2 mg/kg/day). · Children: 0.3–0.5 mg/kg/dose 8–12 hourly (maximum 6 mg/kg/day).

dosing.h: Heart Failure, Acute with Pulmonary Oedema

items.t: Captopril, oral: · Initial dose: 0.5–1 mg/kg/24 hours in 3 divided doses (8 hourly) for 24– 48 hours.
Captopril, oral: · Initial dose: 0.1 mg/kg/dose 8 hourly. · Maximum dose: 2 mg/kg/dose.
Captopril, oral, 0.2 mg/kg/dose, 8–12 hourly, initially. · Adjust dose and interval based on response to a maximum of 1 mg/kg/dose. · Administer 1 hour before feeding.

cautions.t: Short half-life – useful for test dosing

adverse_effects.t: Cough, hyperkalaemia, first-dose hypotension, acute kidney injury, angioedema, taste disturbance

monitoring.t: Potassium and creatinine, BP after the first dose
